PYTHON FOR EVERYONE · CHAPTER 4

Programming Exercises — Loops

Self-graded browser exercises based on the Chapter 4 programming exercises from the textbook.

Coverage: P4.1–P4.27 and Business P4.30–P4.35. Multi-part P4.1–P4.3 are split into individual auto-graded tasks, giving 44 tasks. Toolbox, Science, and Graphics exercises are omitted, matching the existing Chapter 4 exercise notebook.
Feedback: when a submission fails, only the first failing test is shown, with the case/input, expected result, and actual result.
Loop practice rules: the checker requires loop-based solutions and rejects user-defined functions, collections, and shortcut built-ins such as sum(), min(), max(), sorted(), reversed(), and bin().
